title: trifolium pratense var. nivale
intro: Trifolium pratense var. nivale, commonly known as white clover, is a perennial legume plant. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of white clover are attributed to its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of white clover include isoflavones, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
